question: Who was Draupadi Murmu's opponent in the 2022 presidential elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yashwant Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The opponent of Draupadi Murmu in the 2022 presidential elections was Yashwant Sinha.
 
• **Draupadi Murmu** is an Indian politician and former teacher who has been serving as the **15th and current President of India** since 25 July 2022.
 
 
• She won the presidential election as the nominee of the Bhartiya Janta Party (BJP).
 
• She is the** first tribal person and second woman**, after** Pratibha Pati**l, **to hold the office.**
 
• She is the** youngest and first President born in independent India**.
 
• On May 18, 2015, she became **Jharkhand's first female Governor.**
 
 
 
• **Yashwant Sinha** is a **former Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer **and a former member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
 
• He has also **served as the Minister of Finance and External Affairs **in the Government of India.
 
• He was selected by the Combined Opposition Parties as their presidential candidate for the 2022 Presidential election.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mallikarjun Kharge** is an Indian lawyer and politician and has been serving as the **President of the Indian National Congress** since 2022.

 
 
• He has served as the Minister of Railways and the Minister of Labour and Employment in the Government of India.
 
• He has been a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha from Karnataka since 2020.
 
 
 
• **Pranab Mukherjee** was a former President of India and a veteran politician of the Indian National Congress.
 
 
• He has served as the **13th president of India** from 2012 until 2017.
 
• He was Finance Minister from 2009 to 2012 under the UPA government.
 
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor** is an Indian politician and a member of the Indian National Congress.
 
 
• He has served as the Minister of State for External Affairs in the Government of India.
 
• He has been serving as a **Member of Parliament for Thiruvananthapuram,** Kerala, since 2009.
